name: eaglerplatform
description: Self-hosted EaglercraftX platform: website, accounts, Microsoft OAuth, server registry, Eagler WebSocket bridge and Java 1.8 proxy

scripts.build: npm run build -w @eaglerplatform/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w @eaglerplatform/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @eaglerplatform/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @eaglerplatform/shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.migrate: npm run build -w @eaglerplatform/shared && npm run migrate -w server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @eaglerplatform/shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.start: npm run build -w @eaglerplatform/shared && npm run start -w server
